fixture.initial: empty native Layer/first Branch; no source checkpoint imported during setup
fixture.transition: original four-column mode/OID/size/pathhex manifest.tsv and previous.tsv plus changed blobs; previous is prior SELECTED checkpoint
fixture.source_authentication: manifest/tip/index order; exact Git ls-tree raw manifestSHA; every changed blob GitSHA1/rawSHA256; original complete oracleJSON; immutable full157 cached input receipts or direct stride transitions

oracle.scope: every selected original checkpoint from the actual measured Store/history: complete pathhex membership, regular/symlink/directory kinds, regular and directory modes, logical lengths, full SHA256 of regular bytes and symlink target bytes; unchanged original mounted observer plus independent Git-authenticated oracleJSON; all acknowledged parent/state mappings and clean fresh verifier mounts
oracle.omissions: initial empty root is not an original observed-tree checkpoint; original observer excludes root row and does not assert mtime/inode number/link count; retired schema10/packv3 encoding/physical diagnostics are not current-format claims
oracle.mtime_scope: original importer normalizes regular files/directories/root to1000000000 seconds; symlinks keep original timestamp rule; no additional mtime verifier condition
oracle.storage: freeze exact measured Store main+sidecar hashes/logical/allocated bytes after successful performance close and before verifier Fork bookkeeping; retain original storage/resource bounds without component or comparison thresholds

budget.scope: original14400s phase/300s per-operation declarations retained; owner explicit120s external wall stop governs every actual invocation; no selection shrink, retry or timeout increase

differences: The owner explicitly selects all three formerly optional repository profiles. Original case names, indices, source identities, direct selected transitions, full-file ordinary importer and full historical tree oracle remain exact. No skipped states or extra family is added.

Current host public Init creates/seals one empty initial Store for install; the Linux daemon subsequently owns shared global Disposable/WAL/OFF construction and publication in-process. Retired host Store/server topology differs. Overlay remains MEMORY/OFF/EXCLUSIVE; after install host is control-only.

The existing frozen storage-smoke-import and storage-smoke-observe are already callable in the sealed ordinary workload binary and require an actual FUSE mount. Current public SDK mount/Exec/Commit/Fork/History/End/Gone/Stop adapt that route; no lower-level cluster-one history lane or SDK edit substitute is used.

Current Committed corresponds to original Created; full157 retains actual UpToDate mappings while stride3/stride10 keep their explicit Created requirement. Current deterministic identities and retired Commit/object/schema encodings differ; exact acknowledged parents/roots and actual outcomes remain bound.

Original performance Store allocation and hash window closes before verification bookkeeping. Historical verification reads the actual measured history via fresh forks/mounts; it never regenerates or substitutes another producer. Immutable diagnostic copies and public typed proof, when used, are explicitly bound to that export.

Original14400s performance/verification phase and300s operation/transfer/verification declarations are preserved as source metadata; the current owner120s explicit external ceiling governs every invocation. No full selection, fixture, cache, workload or limit is changed to fit. A ceiling failure retains partial acknowledgement/custody and unavailable complete metrics.

Original2CPU/2GiB/no-swap/256PID, OOM/swap,16GiB Store+sidecars,16GiB spool+staging,32GiB owned output,50GiB free reserve,8GiB sampled host RSS and no host-swap delta guards remain declared with actual topology/observation availability. No component history storage threshold or optimization criterion is adopted.

The original tree oracle proves full regular bytes, symlink target bytes, exact names/type/mode/length and directories0755. It omits root row, timestamp verification and inode/link-count assertions. The unchanged importer still performs original regular/directory/root timestamp normalization; automatic symlink timestamps are not replaced with invented constants.

Original prepared corpus and source checkout remain read only; full157 cached transition receipts are authenticated and byte-copied, and strides derive previous.tsv against prior selected state using authenticated original Git blobs. All recipe/helper/manifest/oracle assets are sealed outside product timing.

Paid phase cache coldness and pre-Commit own-write backing residency are unqualified on the shared host/Docker VM. Numeric results remain INELIGIBLE while functional/proof/cleanup outcomes are separately recorded; no speed comparison, acceptance threshold or release gate is selected.
